bio.t1: I enjoy talking about {{a}}, {{b}} and everyday life. I love meaningful conversations and hearing different perspectives.
bio.t5: I enjoy talking about {{a}} and everyday life. I love meaningful conversations and hearing different perspectives.
bio.t2: From {{a}} to {{b}}, I'm here for good conversations and genuine connections.
bio.t3: I'm a good listener and love chatting about {{a}}. If you need a friendly space to share or just want a positive conversation, I'm here.
bio.t4: People come to me for {{a}}, {{b}} and {{c}}. I keep things honest, warm and judgement-free.

bio.g2: I love meeting new people and having real conversations. I'm a good listener and always happy to chat.

bio.g4: Whether it's a tough day or a happy one, I'm here for a friendly, honest conversation.

rates.title: How would you like to connect?
rates.subtitle: Choose the call formats you want to offer. You can set your own rates and change them later.
rates.earn_body: Callers pay your rate for every minute you talk. VibeLive keeps a platform fee and the rest is yours.
rates.fee_rule: Platform fee: {{percent}}% of each call, at least ₹{{min}} per call.
rates.invite_rule: Callers who joined with your invite link: {{percent}}% fee (at least ₹{{min}}), so you get ₹{{amount}}/min.
rates.earn_invite: Share your invite link: everyone who signs up with it pays you at the lower fee, every time they call you.
rates.earn_short: On very short calls the per-call minimum fee applies, so the first minute can pay a little less.
rates.earn_bonus: Minutes a caller pays with free bonus credit are not paid out.
rates.earn_note: Your earnings go to your Earnings wallet after each call. You can withdraw them to your bank once you have ₹{{min}}.
rates.audio_sub: Talk and connect with your audience
rates.earn_desc: You receive this amount for every minute of a completed call.
rates.invite_desc: From people who join with your invite link

availability.title: When can people call you?
availability.subtitle: Choose when you're usually available for calls. You can update this anytime.
availability.now_body: People can call you whenever you're online, no schedule.
availability.slots_body: Calls only in the hours you set for each day.
availability.vacation_body: Pause all calls while you're away. Turn it off to start receiving calls again.

review.title: Review your profile
review.guidelines_title: A few things to keep VibeLive welcoming
review.do1: Be respectful and kind in every conversation
review.do2: Describe your interests and experience honestly
review.do4: Use only your own, recent photos
review.dont1: Harass, threaten or use hate speech
review.dont3: Use fake, edited or AI-generated photos
review.dont4: Ask users to move to other apps or pay off-platform
review.agree_label: I agree to the Host Guidelines and Community Standards
review.guidelines_body: VibeLive is a place for friendly, honest conversations. Hosts who break these rules can be removed from the platform.

submitted.title: Your profile is submitted!

submitted.s2_body: This usually takes a short time.
submitted.s3_body: We'll let you know once it's approved.
submitted.s2_done_body: Our team has checked your profile.
submitted.s3_approved_body: Your profile is approved. You can go online now.
